note: Round-10 additions: 25 recent pharmaceutical patents in IMMUNOLOGY AND INFLAMMATION (9), RESPIRATORY (6), DERMATOLOGY (5) and OPHTHALMOLOGY (5), priority dates 2015-2024, one or two per mechanism class. Same schema as pdf_corpus_round6_manifest.json. source_url is provenance, not a required fetch - the PDFs are committed under benchmarks/corpus/ with SHA256SUMS. n_expected counts the distinct compounds this manifest catalogues (resolved + generic + unresolved rows); n_resolved counts those carrying a PubChem CID. est_structures is the total number of DEPICTIONS and is much larger; where est_structures_is_estimate is true it was counted from a 42-65 dpi contact sheet rather than box by box. ELEVEN files are PAGE EXTRACTS (is_page_extract true, range in pages_kept); in those, every page number in the ground truth refers to the ORIGINAL publication. Every CID was resolved from something PRINTED IN THE DOCUMENT and then CHECKED against the drawing.
retrieval_note: The round-6 routes still work and one of them is faster than recorded. (a) The EPO publication server is unchanged and served all three granted EPs first time: https://data.epo.org/publication-server/rest/v1.2/patents/EP<number>NWB1/document.pdf - B1 ONLY; an A1 request returns HTTP 500, and Google's patentimages has no PDF for an EP A1 either, so an EP A1 is simply not retrievable from this server and its WO twin must be used (this cost two candidates, see rejected). (b) NEW: patents.google.com/xhr/query answers PLAIN curl directly from this server - HTTP 200 in about 0.7 s - even though patents.google.com/patent/<ID>/en still returns 503. Only the SEARCH endpoint is open. Google captchas the direct route after roughly fifteen to twenty queries, at which point the r.jina.ai read-through proxy with 'X-Return-Format: html' still works for both the search endpoint and the patent page. (c) The patent PAGE still has to go through the proxy, and it is what yields the hashed patentimages URL that plain curl then fetches. (d) Search precision: TI%3D(<compound>) - a TITLE-restricted query - is far more useful than free text, which returns mostly third-party documents that merely mention the drug. (e) PubChem PUG-REST rate-limits hard under bursts: first HTTP 503 PUGREST.ServerBusy, then an NCBI 'WWW Error 803' HTML page. A 0.7 s sleep between calls and a 5-attempt backoff was enough. Two PUG-REST route notes: a /compound/smiles/ GET on a SMILES containing a percent-encoded backslash (a cis alkene) returns HTTP 400 BadRequest, and /compound/inchikey/<key>/ is the reliable fallback.
name_to_structure_note: New tooling this round, and it changed at least one reference. `py2opsin` 1.2.0 (OPSIN, bundled jar, installed with uv into .venv-ms) parses a printed IUPAC name to SMILES deterministically. Used as: printed name -> OPSIN -> RDKit canonical SMILES -> InChIKey -> PUG-REST /compound/inchikey/ -> CID. Unlike PUG-REST /compound/name/ it cannot silently return a tautomer or a differently-stereospecified record. It caught the nintedanib substitution and it confirmed the vamorolone and clascoterone steroid stereochemistry independently of the INN lookup. It does NOT parse INNs (tapinarof, ozanimod and the rest are unparseable), so the two routes are complementary, not interchangeable.

accepted.scaffold_class: isoxazoline GABA-gated chloride channel blocker (Demodex blepharitis) - solid state forms
accepted.title: WO 2023/107660 A1, Teva Pharmaceuticals International GmbH, PCT/US2022/052335, international filing date 2022-12-09 (priority IN 202111057565, 2021-12-10), published 2023-06-15, "Solid state forms of lotilaner and process for preparation thereof" - lotilaner is the XDEMVY active for Demodex blepharitis
accepted.licence: Published international (PCT) application, public record
accepted.structure_pages: One structure, p3, under the printed name; pp37-60 are twenty-four numbered figure sheets; pp61-63 the International Search Report
accepted.why: Chosen for its QUATERNARY stereocentre: the isoxazoline C5 carries an aryl, a CF3, a ring oxygen and a ring methylene and no hydrogen at all, so the wedge has to be placed on one of four heavy-atom bonds with no implicit H to anchor it. Twenty-four figure sheets against one structure, several of them annotated solid-state NMR spectra - spiky traces with numbers printed along them, the figure class most easily mistaken for an annotated molecule.
accepted.drawing_style: WIPO A1 full-page raster (PDF::API2), NO text layer. The one structure is drawn with three separate CF3 groups written as expanded F atoms rather than condensed labels, and a quaternary isoxazoline stereocentre

accepted.title: WO 2023/152691 A1, Metrochem API Pvt Ltd, PCT/IB2023/051193, international filing date 2023-02-10 (front-page priority IN 202241007153, 2022-02-10; the body at p2 also claims IN 202241041742 of 2022-07-21), published 2023-08-17, "Process for the preparation of ponesimod and its intermediates thereof"
accepted.licence: Published international (PCT) application, public record
accepted.structure_pages: Formulae (I)-(XXIII) across pp2-24 and the claims pp31-36; Examples 1-13 with drawn intermediates pp25-30; pp37-41 the International Search Report
accepted.why: The round's reference-is-weaker-than-the-drawing case, twice over. The printed name fixes three stereo elements - (2Z), (5Z) and (2R) - but PubChem's ponesimod leaves the propylimino C=N open, and the fully specified InChIKey has no PubChem record at all; the same happens to intermediate (VI). Nine resolved compounds and a clean thiazolidinone/isothiocyanate route besides.
accepted.drawing_style: WIPO A1 full-page raster (PDF::API2), NO text layer. Roman-numeral formulae (I)-(XXIII); the exocyclic thiazolidinone alkene and the propylimino C=N are both drawn with defined geometry

accepted.title: WO 2024/180493 A1, Assia Chemical Industries Ltd (Teva), PCT/IB2024/051909, international filing date 2024-02-28 (priority IN 202311013369, 2023-02-28), published 2024-09-06, "Solid state forms of delgocitinib and process thereof"
accepted.licence: Published international (PCT) application, public record
accepted.structure_pages: One structure, p3; pp57-65 the nine figure sheets; pp4-56 numbered embodiments and peak tables; pp66-69 the International Search Report
accepted.why: Sixty-nine pages and one structure, forty-nine of them an unbroken run of 2-theta peak lists written out in prose. A pure hallucination test - a model that manufactures structures from dense numeric text fails here - wrapped around a genuinely hard depiction: a 1,7-diazaspiro[3.4]octane whose quaternary spiro stereocentre and ring methyl are drawn a few pixels apart.
accepted.drawing_style: WIPO A1 full-page raster (PDF::API2), NO text layer. The one structure is drawn SMALL and cramped, with the spiro centre and the ring methyl distinguished by a hashed and a bold wedge only a few pixels apart at 150 dpi

accepted.structure_pages: Lettered formulae (I)-(IX) inline pp2-33; FIG. 1, the full route with a NAME under every box, on p39; FIG. 2 (XRPD) p40; pp41-44 the International Search Report
accepted.why: Two things nothing else in the round has. FIG. 1 is a numbered DRAWING SHEET that contains chemistry and is printed in LANDSCAPE, rotated ninety degrees against the rest of the file, so an un-rotated read sees every structure sideways; and one of its ten captions is WRONG - box 7 is drawn as a protected ether of the iodo-biphenylcarbonitrile but repeats the caption of box 2, a bromo-tert-butyl succinanilic acid. Name and drawing disagree, which is the same failure class as US4117118A's cyclosporin.

rejected.what: AbbVie, 'Processes for the preparation of (3S,4R)-3-ethyl-4-(3H-imidazo[1,2-a]pyrrolo[2,3-e]pyrazin-8-yl)-N-(2,2,2-trifluoroethyl)pyrrolidine-1-carboxamide' - the upadacitinib family
rejected.why_rejected: Fetched, opened and rejected on the evidence, not on the title. 229 pages and 17.7 MB, and despite the process title the document is CLINICAL: pp13-102 are ninety numbered figure sheets of dose-response curves, bar charts and trial flow diagrams, and pp103-229 are running two-column text with essentially no drawings at all. A title containing 'Processes for the preparation of' is not a screen. WO2021005484A1 was taken instead - a quarter the size and nine specified compounds paired with names in a table.

rejected.what: Glenmark Life Sciences, 'Process for preparation of abrocitinib'
rejected.why_rejected: NOT RETRIEVABLE from this server. The EPO publication server serves B1 documents only (an A1 request returns HTTP 500) and Google's patentimages has no PDF for an EP A1 - the Google Patents page for an A1 carries no hashed PDF link. Its WO twin WO2020261041A1 was taken instead.

rejected.what: Teva Pharmaceuticals International, 'Solid state forms of gefapixant and process for preparation thereof'
rejected.why_rejected: Same A1 problem as EP3989975A1: no patentimages PDF, EPO publication server refuses A1. WO2022083476A1 (Crystal Pharmaceutical, Chinese-language) was taken for the gefapixant slot instead, which also added a second script to the round.

rejected.what: Assia Chemical Industries, 'Processes for the preparation of ritlecitinib and intermediates thereof'
rejected.why_rejected: The Google Patents record exists and the page fetches, but no patentimages PDF has been generated for it yet - published 2025-12-18, too recent. The ritlecitinib slot was left unfilled rather than substituted with a formulation patent.

rejected.what: Takeda GmbH, 'Process for the preparation of roflumilast'
rejected.why_rejected: The obvious topical-PDE4 candidate and the only roflumilast document that draws a route, but granted 2013 - outside the 'roughly 2018 onwards' window. Every recent roflumilast document is an Arcutis ZORYVE FORMULATION patent (US12016848B2, US12310956B2, US20210244718A1) and those draw at most one structure among many pages of excipient tables, which the round already has better examples of.

rejected.what: Boehringer Ingelheim PDE4B inhibitor for IPF
rejected.why_rejected: No document to take. A title search TI=(nerandomilast) on Google Patents returns ZERO results and a free-text search returns only third-party combination and siRNA applications that never draw it. The IPF slot went to EP3747864B1 (nintedanib) instead.

rejected.what: PDGFR/CSF1R/c-KIT inhibitor for pulmonary arterial hypertension
rejected.why_rejected: TI=(seralutinib) returns exactly one document, EP4687674A2, 'Functional respiratory imaging analysis of seralutinib' - an imaging-analysis application with no chemistry. The PAH slot went to EP3344607B1 (selexipag).

The only ciclesonide process document is US8158780B2 (Cipla, 2012) and the fluticasone process art is older still; everything recent is a nebulisation or nasal-suspension FORMULATION patent. Rather than take a pre-2015 document the steroid requirement was met inside the window by US20230002439A1 (vamorolone) and US20250215046A1 (clascoterone), which draw more steroids between them than any inhaled-corticosteroid formulation patent does.

Not a document failure - a DUPLICATE avoidance. US6627754B2_tofacitinib is already in the corpus from round 1, so the JAK stratum here was built from six other, chemically distinct inhibitors: baricitinib, upadacitinib, filgotinib, abrocitinib, delgocitinib and the TYK2 inhibitor deucravacitinib.
